content.comment_body: I'm using [product_name] with article number [article_no] and experiencing problems programming it with [product_name]. My current software is version [version_no], and I keep getting an 'unable to access remote device' error. Is upgrading to [product_name] version [version_no] the only way to connect?

Welcome to the forum, [user_name]. To connect to the device with article number [article_no] ([product_name] [version_no]), you will need [product_name] version [version_no]. You can download the upgrade for free, but the download is restricted and requires an extended registration. You’ll need to log in and provide additional information to access export-restricted software. Alternatively, you can transfer a program created with [product_name] version [version_no] to the device using a microSD card if you don’t have the latest software.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces an inability to program a controller module using software version [version_no], receiving a remote access error. Forum feedback indicates a mismatch between hardware and software versions and advises upgrading to the latest software to resolve the connection issue. An alternative method using a microSD card is also suggested if users are unable to upgrade.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the programming software to connect and program controller modules regardless of small version differences, or, at minimum, to receive clear guidance about which software versions and alternative workflows are required.
